title: The Little Red Hen
source: Traditional folk tale (English/American, 19th century, public domain). Original retelling.
moral: If you help with the work, you get to share the treat.

pages.text: Once upon a time, a little red hen lived on a farm with her friends.
pages.caption: The little red hen

pages.text: One day she found some seeds. "Cluck, cluck! I could grow wheat with these!"
pages.caption: Some little seeds

pages.text: "Who will help me plant the seeds?" asked the little red hen.
pages.caption: Who will help?

pages.text: "Not I," said the pig. "Not I," said the cat. "Not I," said the dog.
pages.caption: Not I, not I

pages.text: "Then I will do it myself," said the little red hen. And she did. Scratch, scratch, pat.
pages.caption: I will do it

pages.text: The sun shone. The rain fell. The little seeds grew up tall and golden.
pages.caption: Growing tall

pages.text: "Who will help me cut the wheat?" asked the little red hen.
pages.caption: Time to cut

pages.text: "Not I," said the pig. "Not I," said the cat. "Not I," said the dog.
pages.caption: Not I again

pages.text: "Then I will do it myself," said the little red hen. Snip, snip, snip!
pages.caption: Snip, snip, snip

pages.text: "Who will help me grind the wheat into flour?" "Not I! Not I! Not I!"
pages.caption: Grinding the wheat

pages.text: "Then I will do it myself." Round and round went the little red hen. Whirr, whirr!
pages.caption: Round and round

pages.text: "Who will help me bake the bread?" "Not I! Not I! Not I!"
pages.caption: Who will bake?

pages.text: "Then I will do it myself." Pat, pat, pat. Into the oven it went. Mmm, what a smell!
pages.caption: Into the oven

pages.text: "Who will help me EAT the bread?" "I will!" said the pig. "I will!" said the cat. "I will!" said the dog.
pages.caption: We will eat it!

pages.text: "Oh no," said the little red hen. "You did not help. So I will eat it with my chicks."
pages.caption: Bread for the chicks

pages.text: The next day, her friends came to help plant. And soon there was warm bread for everyone. The end.
pages.caption: Everyone helps now
